prompt: Locked-off static shot on a tripod: the camera does not move at all, no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no shake. Nothing in the shop moves; the bread, the chocolate bar and the price cards stay perfectly still and the writing on the cards never changes. For the first two seconds the cold fluorescent light is steady. At about two seconds a single horror-film lightning flash bursts through the black window on the left, a hard white-blue light that blasts across the counter and the bread for a split second, flickers once more, and is gone. The light then returns to exactly the same steady fluorescent level as the start and holds, unchanged, to the end of the shot. Outside the window stays black. Low rumble of thunder, the hum of the fluorescent tube. No people, no voices. Thanks.
